questions.prompt: I ______ Terry Fox. I like running and playing basketball.
questions.explanation: 第一人称单数 I 作主语时，一般现在时系动词用 am。
questions.hint: 注意主语是第一人称单数 I。

questions.prompt: Look, they ______ this year's sports stars!
questions.explanation: 主语 they 是复数代词，一般现在时系动词用 are。
questions.hint: 注意主语 they 是复数形式。

questions.prompt: That ______ my friend, Wang Li. She can run very fast.
questions.explanation: 主语 That 是指示代词单数，一般现在时系动词用 is。
questions.hint: That 表示单数概念。

questions.prompt: And that ______ Li Min. He can play basketball very well.
questions.explanation: 主语 That 是单数，一般现在时系动词用 is。
questions.hint: That 是单数指示代词。

questions.prompt: ______ that Zhu Chen? Yes, she can swim very fast.
questions.explanation: 句首一般疑问句中，主语 that 是单数，系动词用 Is。
questions.hint: 主语是单数 that，放在句首首字母大写。

questions.prompt: They______ all good at sports and they all work very hard.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是复数代词，系动词用 are（可缩写为 They're）。
questions.hint: They 是复数人称代词。

questions.prompt: It______ hard for me. Many kind people help me.
questions.explanation: 主语 It 是第三人称单数，系动词用 is（可缩写为 It's）。
questions.hint: It 属于第三人称单数。

questions.prompt: It______ OK. It______ OK. It______ OK to fail.
questions.explanation: 主语 It 是第三人称单数，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: 主语是单数 It。

questions.prompt: But I______ very ill. I can't run anymore.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，一般现在时系动词用 am（可缩写为 I'm）。
questions.hint: 第一人称 I 搭配 am。

questions.prompt: Daming______ Existing Abilities
questions.explanation: 主语 Daming's Existing Abilities 整体或所有格核心词若视为单数概念/标题，系动词用 is。此处考察专有名词所有格作主语的单复数匹配。
questions.hint: 注意主语的单复数形式。

questions.prompt: Welcome ______ Sports Day!
questions.explanation: 固定句型 Welcome to... 中，Welcome 后面接动词原形 be 构成欢迎短语或祈使句结构（此处为Welcome to）。在语法填空中考查原形 be 的搭配。
questions.hint: 欢迎来到……使用 Welcome to。

questions.prompt: Sports Day! Sports Day! Come on, everybody!
questions.explanation: 补充操练：当谈论单个节日/活动 Sports Day 时，视作第三人称单数，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: Sports Day 是单数名词词组。

questions.prompt: ______ you jump high, Daming?
questions.explanation: 注：本题为语法变形专项，将含有情态动词的句子转化为考察be动词的变体逻辑（或专项巩固be动词在疑问句中的用法）。
questions.hint: 巩固be动词的基础用法。

questions.prompt: I ______ swim now.
questions.explanation: 当主语是 I 且需要be动词时用 am。
questions.hint: 主语是第一人称 I。

questions.prompt: Wow! You ______ swim fast!
questions.explanation: 主语是第二人称 You，若使用系动词或系表结构时用 are。
questions.hint: 第二人称 you 搭配 are。

questions.prompt: Come on, Terry! You ______ do it!
questions.explanation: 基础系动词/动词原形辨析：在祈使或助动词语境中，You 后面接原形或 are。
questions.hint: 注意人称代词 you 的搭配。

questions.prompt: Don't give up! Never stop! ______ hard!
questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，构成“Be + 形容词”结构（如 Be hard / Be careful）。
questions.hint: 祈使句要用动词原形 be 开头。

questions.prompt: Sports Stars Profiling ______ interesting.
questions.explanation: 主语 Profiling 或短语整体作为单数概念时，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: 单数主语搭配 is。

questions.prompt: ______ I help other people?
questions.explanation: 若主语是 I，疑问句式中常用 Am 开头（此处为be动词专项变体练习）。
questions.hint: 第一人称 I 对应的be动词形式。

questions.prompt: But I ______ lose one leg because of cancer.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，一般现在时系动词用 am。
questions.hint: 主语 I 搭配 am。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can run and swim.
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，将 Can 提到句首，第一人称 I 相应变为 you，句末加问号。
questions.hint: 句子含有情态动词 can，变疑问句时把 can 提前，I 变为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can jump high and far.
options: Do you jump high and far?
Can you jump high and far?
Are you jump high and far?
Can you jumps high and far?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，Can 提前，第一人称 I 改为 you，动词保持原形 jump。
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 提前，后接动词原形。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I like playing sports.
questions.explanation: 谓语动词 like 为实义动词原形，主语变为 you 时，变一般疑问句需借助助动词 Do 置于句首。
questions.hint: 实义动词 like 变一般疑问句，主语为 you 时借助助动词 Do。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can play football and basketball.
options: Do you play football and basketball?
Are you play football and basketball?
Does you play football and basketball?
Can you play football and basketball?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的句子，疑问句直接将 Can 置于句首，I 转换为 you。
questions.hint: 注意句中含有情态动词 can。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can play ping-pong and volleyball.
options: Can you play ping-pong and volleyball?
Do you play ping-pong and volleyball?
Are you play ping-pong and volleyball?
Can you plays ping-pong and volleyball?
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 提前至句首，I 转换为 you，动词保持原形 play。
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 提前，注意人称变换。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can swim now.
questions.explanation: 含 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句：Can + 主语(you) + 动词原形(swim) + 其他？
questions.hint: Can 提前，后接动词原形 swim。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
You can swim fast.
questions.explanation: 句中含有情态动词 can，将 Can 直接提前至句首构成一般疑问句：Can you swim fast?
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 直接提前。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
Terry loses one leg.
questions.explanation: 主语 Terry 为第三人称单数，谓语动词 loses 为实义动词单三形式，变一般疑问句借助动词 Does 提前，后面动词恢复原形 lose。
questions.hint: 第三人称单数 Terry 借助动词 Does，动词 loses 恢复原形 lose。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
Terry likes running.
questions.explanation: 主语 Terry 是第三人称单数，谓语 likes 是实义动词，变疑问句用助动词 Does，likes 还原为原形 like。
questions.hint: 助动词 Does 提前，动词 likes 变回原形 like。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can run across Canada.
questions.explanation: 含有 can 的陈述句变疑问句，将 Can 提前，I 改为 you，动词保持原形 run。
questions.hint: 把 can 提到句首，I 变为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
I can get money for people.
options: Do you get money for people?
Are you get money for people?
Can you get money for people?
Does you get money for people?
questions.explanation: 含情态动词 can 的句子，变一般疑问句把 Can 移到句首，I 改为 you。
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 提前，第一人称 I 改为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
Many kind people help me.
options: Does many kind people help you?
Are many kind people help you?
Can many kind people help you?
Do many kind people help you?
questions.explanation: 主语 Many kind people 为复数名词，help 为实义动词原形，变一般疑问句在句首加助动词 Do，人称代词宾格 me 转换为 you。
questions.hint: 主语 people 是复数，借助助动词 Do，me 转换为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
Terry keeps running for five months.
options: Does Terry keep running for five months?
Does Terry keeps running for five months?
Do Terry keep running for five months?
Is Terry keep running for five months?
questions.explanation: 主语 Terry 为第三人称单数，keeps 是实义动词单三形式，疑问句借助动词 Does 提前，keeps 还原为原形 keep。
questions.hint: 第三人称单数借助动词 Does，动词恢复原形 keep。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
Many people do the Terry Fox Run every year.
options: Does many people do the Terry Fox Run every year?
Do many people do the Terry Fox Run every year?
Are many people do the Terry Fox Run every year?
Can many people do the Terry Fox Run every year?
questions.explanation: 主语 Many people 为复数，do 为实义动词，变一般疑问句借助助动词 Do 置于句首：Do many people do...?
questions.hint: 主语 people 是复数，助动词用 Do。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
You can run very fast.
questions.explanation: 含情态动词 can 的句子，变疑问句直接将 Can 提前至句首：Can you run very fast?
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 直接提前。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
They are this year's sports stars.
options: Do they are this year's sports stars?
Do they this year's sports stars?
Is they this year's sports stars?
Are they this year's sports stars?
questions.explanation: 含有系动词 are 的句子，变一般疑问句直接将 Are 移到句首：Are they this year's sports stars?
questions.hint: 含 be 动词 are，直接将 Are 提前。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
That is my friend, Wang Li.
options: Is that your friend, Wang Li?
Does that your friend, Wang Li?
Are that your friend, Wang Li?
Is that you friend, Wang Li?
questions.explanation: 含有系动词 is 的句子变一般疑问句，将 Is 提前至句首，物主代词 my 转换为 your。
questions.hint: 系动词 is 提前至句首，my 变为 your。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
She can run very fast.
questions.explanation: 含情态动词 can 的句子，变一般疑问句将 Can 提到句首，动词保持原形 run：Can she run very fast?
questions.hint: 情态动词 Can 提前，后接动词原形 run。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
He can play basketball very well.
options: Does he play basketball very well?
Is he play basketball very well?
Can he play basketball very well?
Can he plays basketball very well?
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 提前至句首，主语 he，动词保持原形 play：Can he play basketball very well?
questions.hint: 把情态动词 Can 提前，动词保持原形 play。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
They all work very hard.
options: Does they all work very hard?
Are they all work very hard?
Can they all work very hard?
Do they all work very hard?
questions.explanation: 主语 they 为复数代词，work 为实义动词原形，变一般疑问句借助助动词 Do 置于句首：Do they all work very hard?
questions.hint: 实义动词 work，主语 they 为复数，借助助动词 Do。
